source: BlizzCon 2026 demo tooltips; Wowhead "Warcraft: Forever Legacy System Explained" (12 Sep 2026)
pointCapNote: The overall Legacy Point cap (and thus the interactive spend-and-plan flow) is not yet known or confirmed. This page is a static reference until a real cap is confirmed.

perks.name: Well Rested
perks.description: Your rested experience accumulates 4% faster and your rested experience cap is increased by 4%.

perks.name: Talented
perks.description: You gain talent points every level starting at level 9 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.

perks.name: High Alert
perks.description: Increases your ability to detect nearby targets with Stealth as if your level were increased by 1. Ineffective in battlegrounds.

perks.name: Thrill of Adventure
perks.description: You gain 1% of your maximum Health and Mana over 10 sec each time you deliver the killing blow to a non-trivial enemy. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

perks.name: Field Guide
perks.description: Reduces your cooldown on adding Camp features by 8%.

perks.name: Frequent Flier
perks.description: You receive a 50% discount on all flight paths, and your flight path mount flies 20% faster.

perks.name: Field Medicine
perks.description: Reduces the duration of the Recently Bandaged effect by 5 sec when you use a bandage. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

perks.name: The Quick and the Dead
perks.description: Increases movement speed while dead by 5% and your helpful spells and abilities cost no resources for 1 min after being resurrected or until you enter combat.

perks.name: Reinforce
perks.description: You take 6% less durability loss when you die.

perks.name: Permanence
perks.description: Your class abilities which grant long-duration stat or attribute benefits to all party or raid members last 50% longer, and the benefits you gain from resting at a camp last 50% longer.

perks.name: Gourmand
perks.description: Increases the duration of beneficial effects from eating food by 33%.

perks.name: Reagent Economy
perks.description: Your class abilities no longer require reagents purchasable from vendors, and your Tier 1 camping features cost no reagents to craft.

perks.name: Working Overtime
perks.description: Increases your chance to gain a skill increase from using any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill by 4%.

perks.name: Performance Bonus
perks.description: You have a 5% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.

perks.name: Luremaster
perks.description: While fishing with a lure active, you have a 25% chance to catch an extra fish.

perks.name: Master Chef
perks.description: Your cooking recipes have a 10% chance to create an extra result.

perks.name: Dedicated Study
perks.description: Increases your skill by 1 in your lowest tradeskill among your Primary and Secondary tradeskills. If you have already reached 300 skill in your two current Primary tradeskills and all three Secondary Tradeskills, you will gain 2 to 4 of a random Elemental Essence.

rewards.note: Point thresholds for each reward are not yet known or confirmed. Only a partial list has been revealed so far, from the BlizzCon gameplay demo -- more rewards likely exist at higher thresholds.

items.name: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle
items.description: Fires shots at other players, stunning them on a hit. Stuns (and kills) with this are tracked.
